frase_inicial: Timothy and Melanie: protect Liam and Josh first, using money you already have

tarjetas.frente: The high-rate credit card is holding you back
tarjetas.reverso: Keeping that card means you pay more interest each month while cash sits idle. Clearing it frees money and lifts one of the plan limits.
tarjetas.detalle: Pay $6,800 from accessible cash toward the Chase credit card (18%); balance after move: $11,200 remaining on card.

tarjetas.frente: Life cover is thinner than the kids need
tarjetas.reverso: If one earner stopped, your current life policies would not replace the household income the kids depend on. Adding cover protects Liam and Josh.
tarjetas.detalle: Plan recommends adding $235,000 of life insurance to reach $485,000 total; after card paydown target rises to $491,800.

tarjetas.frente: You have a large cash cushion you can use
tarjetas.reverso: You already hold more cash than the emergency reserve. A portion can go to fix the card and start closing protection gaps without risking day-to-day needs.
tarjetas.detalle: Accessible cash: $150,800; cash above reserve and near-term goals: $60,222.50 available to reallocate.

tarjetas.frente: No umbrella policy leaves assets exposed
tarjetas.reverso: Your house, cars and savings could be reached by a big claim. Adding umbrella cover would protect the money you plan to keep for the kids.
tarjetas.detalle: Plan gap: $1,000,000 of umbrella liability; no umbrella policy listed.

tarjetas.frente: College is unfunded but time gives options
tarjetas.reverso: Liam and Josh start college years from now, so small yearly saving now can build the fund. Decide how education shares cash with protection.
tarjetas.detalle: Total college funding gap: $113,508.60; extra yearly saving needed first-year: $4,609.22.

movimientos.title: Pay down revolving card
movimientos.action: Pay $6,800 on the 18% card from cash to remove high revolving exposure and clear the gate

movimientos.title: Add life cover
movimientos.action: Add $235,000 of life cover to raise the mortality ratio and clear the gate

movimientos.action: Add $1M of umbrella to raise the liability shield

siguiente_paso.razon: Paying down the high-rate card first removes the plan limit that keeps your score low and uses cash you already hold, while leaving your emergency cushion intact.
pasos: Sit together at the computer or phone
Open the bank app holding your cash account
Make a one-time payment toward the Chase card for $6,800 from the cash account
